missing-test on phase: aff verdict must exit 0 when a test-id or hash delta is covered by a verified amendment and the allowlist is unchanged

Observed: tests/test_verdict.py has no subprocess test where a valid signed amendment makes an oracle or hash change pass

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Fix work-item fix-verdict-exit covers this finding. Do not reopen done tasks.
